players.name: Jeremiah Smith
players.note: PFF credits him with 52 catches for 984 yards and 12 TDs, but Julian Sayin's arm injury leaves a freshman QB throwing to him starting Oct. 31 at USC.

players.name: Darian Mensah
players.note: Kiper's Oct. 30 board has him QB2 and PFF named him a Week 8 stock riser; he carried 81.4% completions, 2,151 yards, 22 TDs and 1 INT into Week 9 for No. 1 Miami, with a Nov. 7 test vs. Notre Dame.

players.name: Drew Mestemaker
players.note: Mel Kiper's QB1 on his Oct. 30 big board after a 389-yard, 3-TD game in the 41-24 win over West Virginia, on top of the 317-yard passing, 109-yard rushing upset of Oregon.

players.name: CJ Carr
players.note: QB4 on Kiper's Oct. 30 board, but Footballguys' Oct. 21 board still warns he may return to school.

players.name: Arch Manning
players.note: Slid to QB6 on Kiper's Oct. 30 board, behind Mestemaker, Mensah, Chambliss, Carr and Austin Simmons, and Footballguys projects a likely return to school.

players.name: Trinidad Chambliss
players.note: Kiper's QB3 on his Oct. 30 board despite going 25-of-52 with 3 INTs in the 34-27 loss at Texas; as a senior, he's the safest bet in the class to actually be in the 2027 draft.

players.name: Jadan Baugh
players.note: PFF had him at 438 rushing yards and 8 TDs through three games, but Missouri held him to 13 yards on 12 carries in early October.

players.name: Dante Moore
players.note: Dan Lanning said Oct. 26 that Moore is not expected to return this season after the September concussion vs. USC, and declined to say whether he'll be back at Oregon in 2027.

players.name: Austin Simmons
players.note: Ole Miss transfer who cracked Kiper's top 10 and is QB5 on his Oct. 30 board, but AtoZ Sports reports NFL sources believe he plans to return to school for 2027.

players.name: Julian Sayin
players.note: Out indefinitely with a throwing-arm elbow injury suffered vs. Indiana, and Ryan Day is planning for him to miss the regular season and possibly the postseason.

players.name: Charlie Becker
players.note: PFF Week 7 stock riser after a 9-catch, 165-yard game against Ohio State.

players.name: Cam Coleman
players.note: Footballguys is still waiting on his breakout as Texas' offense sputtered before the Oct. 24 win over Ole Miss.

players.name: Ryan Coleman-Williams
players.note: High-ceiling receiver ranked WR3 by Matt Miller; drops have remained a concern in 2026.

players.name: KJ Duff
players.note: Surging with 45 catches for 774 yards and 9 TDs heading into the Michigan game.

players.name: Trey'Dez Green
players.note: Back from his Week 3 knee injury: 5 catches, 50 yards and a TD in LSU's 38-17 win at Auburn after missing four games.

players.name: Isaac Brown
players.note: Top-five RB on Matt Miller's list and 18th in DraftSharks' superflex rankings.

players.name: Mark Fletcher Jr.
players.note: Senior power back on Miami's unbeaten offense who shared top billing with Mensah in the 41-13 win at Clemson.

players.name: Kewan Lacy
players.note: Dislocated his shoulder in the Oct. 24 loss at Texas and was ruled out vs. Auburn, his third separate 2026 injury after a leg bruise and an earlier shoulder issue.

players.name: Bryant Wesco Jr.
players.note: Separator with 1,245 career yards; slow 2026 start with 16 catches for 163 yards through late September.

players.name: John Mateer
players.note: Led Oklahoma's 27-24 Red River win over Texas on Oct. 10 but has appeared on the injury report since.

players.name: LaNorris Sellers
players.note: NFL personnel staffers called him stock down in CBS's October survey of the 2027 QB class.

players.name: Nate Frazier
players.note: Played through injured ribs, per Footballguys' Oct. 21 board.

players.name: Ryan Wingo
players.note: Led Texas with 834 yards in 2025 and opened 2026 with a 7-121-1 game.

players.name: TJ Moore
players.note: 837-yard 2025 producer ranked 19th by DraftSharks; Clemson's offense managed just 13 points against Miami on Oct. 3.

players.name: Jayden Maiava
players.note: 6-foot-4 returning starter ranked QB6 on B/R's board after 23 TDs in 2025.

players.name: Ahmad Hardy
players.note: Still had not returned from his offseason gunshot-wound rehab as of Footballguys' Oct. 21 board.

players.name: Sam Leavitt
players.note: Arizona State transfer in Lane Kiffin's offense who was a PFF Week 1 stock riser after LSU's rout of Clemson, with scouts debating Day 2 vs. first-round value.

players.name: Nyck Harbor
players.note: Rare size-speed athlete ranked WR4 by NFL Draft Bible and spotlighted in PFF's Week 5 stock report.

players.name: Justice Haynes
players.note: Senior back in Brugler's top five running backs.

players.name: Duce Robinson
players.note: Big-bodied receiver in NFL Draft Bible's WR top five and Roto Street Journal's superflex mock.

players.name: Luke Reynolds
players.note: PFF Week 8 stock riser at tight end, moving up from Walter Football's TE6 slot.

players.name: Jamari Johnson
players.note: Falls after PFF named him a Week 6 stock-down tight end, though CBS and ESPN still rate him a top inline TE.

players.name: Raleek Brown
players.note: Explosive back on Matt Miller's top-five RB list.

players.name: Reed Harris
players.note: Contested-catch transfer flagged as a PFF stock riser in 2026.

players.name: Terrance Carter Jr.
players.note: Productive but undersized (6-2, 245) tight end ranked TE3-TE5 by most boards.

players.name: Peter Clarke
players.note: Led all FBS tight ends with a 90.5 PFF grade in 2025; TE4 on PFF and ESPN lists.

players.name: Caleb Odom
players.note: Big receiving tight end who appears on DraftSharks' 2027 board.

players.name: Jeremiah Hasley
players.note: Walter Football's TE7 in its September 2026 update.

players.name: Decker DeGraaf
players.note: Appears in ESPN analysts' top-five 2027 tight ends.

players.name: DJ Vonnahme
players.note: Appears in ESPN analysts' top-five 2027 tight ends.

players.name: Drake Lindsey
players.note: NFL personnel staffers labeled him stock down in CBS's October survey of the 2027 QB class.
